تبتذلوا (form VIII)
# تَبْتَذِلُوا (tabtaḏilū) /tab.ta.ði.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# تُبْتَذَلُوا (tubtaḏalū) /tub.ta.ða.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
